jobs.title: Senior Field Marketing Manager (London)
jobs.description: Developers don’t want more marketing. They want relevance, technical depth, and experiences worth showing up for. As Senior Field Marketing Manager, you will help bring Coder’s regional marketing programs to life. You will execute field and ABM programs that build awareness, support sales, and create pipeline across the European market. You will work closely with a Senior Marketing Manager, sales, partners, and the broader marketing team. You will coordinate events, activate campaigns, and keep programs moving on time and on brand. jobs.why: This is a senior, London-focused field marketing role centered on events and ABM, making it a heavy stretch for a remote junior copywriter.
jobs.proposal_opener: Developers tune out generic marketing fast—what actually converts them is high-relevance messaging and sharp ABM copy that respects their technical depth. I can support your European pipeline by writing the exact high-converting copy your account-based campaigns need.
jobs.flags: Senior title, location-specific to London/Europe, focused on in-person field marketing and ABM
jobs.summary: This role leads regional field marketing and account-based marketing (ABM) programs across Europe to generate pipeline for Coder. It focuses on executing relevant developer-focused experiences, events, and sales-aligned outreach.
